subject: Acme Health — confirmation of opt-out from model training & retention requirements
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Emma Sinclair <emma@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: data handling recap & training opt-out (Acme Health)

Hi Emma / Tom —

Thanks again for the demo today — great to learn more about the care coordination workflows and the PII controls you require. Per our conversation, I wanted to recap the items we agreed and list the next steps so we can get this reflected in the contract amendment and infra config: 

Summary from call:
- Acme Health requests that Redwood NOT use any customer-provided data to continue training or tune models (explicit opt-out for model improvement).
- Data residency requirement: EU (eu-west-1) for all logged payloads and any persisted artifacts.
- Retention: logs and request payloads retained for up to 12 months (rolled policy), unless otherwise required for billing/audit.
- PII handling: you require default redaction at ingestion for SSNs and full names in free text; we discussed schema-based redaction + customer-side tokenization as an option.
- Logging controls: only request metadata (time, model, request-id) to be kept in central telemetry; request bodies to be restricted to the eu region and subject to retention policy above.

Next steps I have captured: 
1) Acme to confirm formally the opt-out (signed PDF is fine).
2) Redwood Legal to draft a short amendment that adds the "no-training-on-customer-data" clause and updates retention/residency obligations.
3) Infra/Platform (Aditya) to prepare a configuration: tag Acme tenant -> disable model tuning flag, enforce eu storage, set retention window to 12 months.
4) Redwood to share updated DPA + amendment for signature.

If this recap looks accurate, please reply with the signed opt-out and any edits to retention/residency language. Once we have that we'll open a change ticket and target a formal amendment within a week.

Cheers,

Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

From: Emma Sinclair <emma@acmehealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Bryant <tom.bryant@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:17:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Follow-up: data handling recap & training opt-out (Acme Health)

Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear summary. Confirming on behalf of Acme Health: we require an explicit opt-out from any training/tuning using Acme customer data. Please consider this email our formal confirmation.

Additional clarifications: 
- Residency: all request payloads and any persisted logs must remain in EU (eu-west-1).
- Retention: 12 months max, unless required for legal/regulatory audit.
- PII: please enable ingestion redaction for SSNs and patient identifiers; well follow up with a sample schema for any domain-specific fields.
- Logging: well accept telemetry that does not include raw request bodies; request-ids, timestamps, and aggregate usage are fine.

Attached is our signed opt-out letter. Let me know if you need a formal PO or SOW change for procurement.

Best,
Emma Sinclair
Head of IT Security — Acme Health
emma@acmehealth.com

Attachments: acme-training-optout-signed.pdf (stub)

Vanessa / Aditya —

Thanks for the ping. Legal has reviewed the confirmation and the DPA; well prepare a short amendment that: (1) inserts an explicit "no training" clause; (2) states data residency for logs/payloads as eu-west-1; (3) specifies the 12-month retention window and an audit clause. Ive attached the initial amendment draft for your review.

Operational notes: 
- The amendment references our internal control ID RW-TR-210 (model tuning disable feature). Product/Platform will need to toggle this on the Acme tenant and add a tenancy-level flag to prevent accidental snapshots.
- For PII redaction, we'll accept Acme's schema; please route the sample schema to product-security@redwood.com.
- We'll route the amendment for signature via DocuSign once you confirm the wording; target turnaround 3 business days after confirmation.

Aditya: can you confirm estimated ETA to enforce residency + retention and confirm whether any migration window is required? If it's > 72 hours we should note that in the amendment.
